sn47.37:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpi sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.37:1.4: Tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato yo kāyasmiṃ chando so pahīyati ||
sn47.37:4.1: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.37:4.2: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato yo dhammesu chando so pahīyati ||
sn47.37:4.3: chandassa pahānā amatam sacchikataṃ hotī ti || || 2.
